name: ddd-implementing
description: Vaughn Vernon's Implementing Domain-Driven Design as a Claude Code toolkit: skills, subagents and output styles for bounded contexts in code, small aggregates, repositories, domain events, application services and anticorruption layers.

inject_rules.title: Inject the compact rules at session start
inject_rules.description: Adds the short Implementing Domain-Driven Design rule set to every session as always-on context. Leave off when you use several book plugins; the skills load the rules on demand.
